name: What She Meant
source:
There are women who get bored of almost everything.

And sometimes of almost everyone.

That's not a flaw. It's an architecture.

What She Meant is an interactive visual novel with a real scientific foundation. It doesn't teach you to conquer — it teaches you to see.

Every decision you make has real psychological grounding.

Every mistake has an explanation.

Every right move unlocks something most people never know.

[From [url=https://julian-ortega-murillo.itch.io/whatshemeant]itch.io[/url]]
